title: Cancel viscosity bias with a fixed spatially translated affine word
statement: For a one-coordinate shear F, B(F,F)=0 and L_F Delta F=0. Emitting f=w_t for w=c(t)F gives exact affine analysis action A_F^nu(a)v=exp(-aL_F)v+nu a Delta F. For the accepted concrete word W(s)=exp(s^4D)+O(s^5), underlying transport I and Fourier-multiplier D, affine bias b(s)=sum c_j s E_m...E_(j+1)Delta F_j has degree-j Taylor coefficient supported in |k|infinity<=j Kcat,j<=4. Differentiate only fixed smooth vectors, not transport groups in operator norm. Construct FIXED positive rational unit-circle quadrature annihilating all nonzero modes |k|infinity<=4Kcat: n=2K+1 rational points close to roots of unity, rational Fourier-system solution with positive weights, tensor in3coordinates and clear denominators to integer multiplicities. Rational unit-circle coordinates give rational phases of every integer Fourier mode, without rational angles. Translated words retain D; direct affine terms through4 cancel and cross bias is O(s^5), since completed W-I=O(s^4). Fixed superword has Wbar=exp(J0 s^4D)+O(s^5), bbar=O(s^5), exact underlying transport I. Analysis correction a_nu solves a_t+L_w a=nu Delta w, with partial Hm norm<=C(s+n s^5)exp(C n s^5), endpoint<=C n s^5 exp(C n s^5), uniformly nu<=1. Set gamma=e/[C(K+1)],qa=min(gamma,r,mu0),Ta=C gamma^-4,s=min(s0,qa/[C(Ta+1)]),n=ceil(Ta/s^4). Then Wbar^n H1->L2 norm<=gamma, partial H6 correction<=min(r,mu0)/100, endpoint<=e/100. Count n<=C(gamma^-24+gamma^-20 r^-4+gamma^-20 mu0^-4); rational quadratic velocity legs in duration delta emit force peak<=C s n^2 delta^-2. Exact residual of reference w+a_nu is nu Delta a_nu-B(a_nu,a_nu); large L_w a_nu cancels. Small added velocity/induction operators allow accepted coupled reset with lower coercivities nu0,rho0, paid Lorentz C nu0^-1 rho0^-1/2 Kstar^4 delta^.5. Use sigma=min(dbud/4,c mu0^7 r0^8 Kstar^-20),e=c nu0 r0 sigma,delta=min(dbud/4,c mu0^3 r^4 e^4 Kstar^-12), then unforced smoothing. This uses the supplied effective word and joint estimates, not an arbitrary unknown-viscosity carrier-tracking claim.
